approvedSentences.imageNotes: Use the recurring protagonist girl identity and recurring protagonist mother identity. The protagonist girl lies in bed resting and looks sick and uncomfortable; her mother sits beside the bed caring for her with a concerned expression. No visible medical text, diagnosis sheets, readable labels, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, logos, UI symbols, or watermarks.

Use the recurring protagonist girl identity and distinct classmate children. The protagonist girl sits on a bench beside a playground or park path, gently touching her own right foot, while classmates run nearby; she temporarily cannot run with them. Keep the scene calm, not severely injured or frightening. No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, labels, arrows, logos, UI symbols, or watermarks.

No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, labels, arrows, signs, logos, UI symbols, or watermarks.

A friendly small dog runs straight ahead along a sidewalk toward a visible street or wall corner ahead. Use the recurring protagonist girl identity behind the dog, watching it run. Make the straight path and the corner clear without using arrows, labels, text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, signs, logos, UI symbols, or watermarks.

Use the recurring protagonist girl identity in a room. On the floor in the right-side corner of the room, one handmade paper flower has fallen; nearby or on a table are simple paper-flower craft materials. The girl looks at the fallen paper flower. No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, labels, arrows, logos, UI symbols, or watermarks.
